## FORMAT with RANGE values
# Confirmed against BigQuery, which names the element type of a RANGE that a specifier rejects,
# also of one in an ARRAY, and says INT64 where GoogleSQL says integer.

SELECT FORMAT('%s', RANGE<DATE> '[2020-01-01, 2020-02-01)')
=> error: Invalid type for argument 2 to FORMAT; Expected STRING; Got DATE at [1:8]

SELECT FORMAT('%d', r) FROM UNNEST([RANGE<TIMESTAMP> '[2020-01-01, 2020-02-01)']) AS r
=> error: Invalid type for argument 2 to FORMAT; Expected INT64; Got TIMESTAMP at [1:8]

SELECT FORMAT('%d', [RANGE<DATE> '[2020-01-01, 2020-02-01)'])
=> error: Invalid type for argument 2 to FORMAT; Expected INT64; Got DATE at [1:8]
